basis: Before formal Y05 execution, current r74 native list2000 plus open-file metadata baseline: first94.36ms;20warm p50=99.38ms,p95=104.17ms,max105.26ms. This exploratory baseline is not FileService/App acceptance and did not flush OS disk caches.

The1000ms per-snapshot bound retains the existing root-list engineering feasibility envelope; it is not a retrospective budget for the old8ms research stat-only result. All natural cold/warm samples must meet the bound and report p50/p95/max.

200ms is a pre-execution soft trigger with approximately2x native-baseline allowance for main-process/protocol/sorting overhead. Runtime crossing must reduce request frequency and show status; deliberately delayed original IO is recorded separately.

Per shared physical root use conservative measured wall time for at most10percent scheduled scan duty, min1s polling/max30s idle backoff. Wall duty is not a claim of measured process CPU utilization. Submillisecond model work is not a meaningful timing sample.

Cold App samples mean the first complete target-membership snapshot in a fresh App process; warm samples are later complete snapshots in one App/consumer. Service-I cold context is named separately. No OS disk-cache-cold claim.
budget.changePolicy: Freeze E1 before formal performance runs. Preserve failures; do not silently relax this file, change membership scope, or count throttled/partial results as the full expected tree.

rows.boundary: I cold means a fresh FileService/roots/watcher context; not a fresh App or disk-cache-cold claim. All natural results come from the packaged original native broker; three exact membership paths, no closed descendant traversal.
